title: Bachelor Programmes Open to International Students at Chinese Universities (2026)

programme_id.description: Row id: `<university_id>__<programme slug>` (a suffix -2, -3 separates programmes of the same name in different schools or languages).

university_id.description: Stable slug of the university, the same id as in the other Long Bet datasets (e.g. `tsinghua-university`).

programme_name_en.description: Programme (major) name in English as listed in the catalogue.

school_or_faculty.description: School, faculty or department that runs the programme.

language.description: Language of instruction: `zh` Chinese, `en` English, `zh_en` bilingual, `fr` French.

is_stem.description: `true` for natural sciences, mathematics, computing, engineering, materials, earth, environmental and life sciences, biomedical engineering; `false` for medicine, pharmacy, architecture, economics, business, humanities and social sciences. Classified from the programme name.

joint_institute.description: Name of the joint institute or partner university when the programme is run with one; null otherwise.

status.description: `found` = the fact was read on the source page; `not_found` = the page was checked and the fact is not there: the row records what was looked for, `source_url` gives the URL tried and `note` says what was missing.

source_url.description: Page(s) where the fact is stated, "; "-separated, primary pages first. For `not_found` rows: the page(s) tried.

source_type.description: `official` = university, government, embassy, airport or ranking publisher page; `law` = legal act; `secondary` = media, Wikipedia, agencies, aggregators.

checked_at.description: Date the row was last read on the source, ISO 8601.

confidence.description: `verified` = read on an official or legal page for the current cycle; `partial` = official but older cycle or incomplete, or a reputable secondary source; `estimate` = derived or calculated, method in `note`. Empty for `not_found` rows.

note.description: Caveats in English. "Updated 2026-10-23:" marks text added by the second verification pass of 23 October 2026.
